7.6.3 Cyclic Deterministic Execution
This section describes the APIs shown in Figure 7.16, and how they need to be used
by a
process
to execute deterministically, so the
process
can be transparently inte-
grated into a software lockstep environment.
7.6.3.1 Control of Cyclic Execution
Execution Management
provides an API to trigger and control recurring, i.e. cyclic
execution of the main thread code within a
process
.
